question: E, F, G, H, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). L sits to the immediate right of F. Only three people sit between L and H when counted from the left of L. Only three people sit between F and J when counted from the left of F. E sits to the immediate right of K. How many people sit between F and K when counted from the right of K?
solution:
E, F, G, H, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order).

 
• L sits to the immediate right of F.
 
• Only three people sit between L and H when counted from the left of L.
 
• Only three people sit between F and J when counted from the left of F.
 
• E sits to the immediate right of K
